messages:
maria_devex: quick async — what I did / blockers / today
- Did: uploaded VTT captions for the new quickstart demo video to CDN (public URL posted in docs PR).
- Blocker: caption pipeline (ffmpeg->whisper->vtt) is dropping speaker labels for multiline captions; makes the demo harder to follow.
- Today: patch captioner to preserve speaker cues, run link-checker across quickstarts, and shepherd sample-app PR #412 through review.

noah_docs: thanks — FYI the caption tool accepts `--speaker-boundary` but our wrapper strips it. I can add a flag to the wrapper tonight and add a small unit test.

tess_swe: CI heads-up: sample-app e2e failing on CI for forks — 403 when fetching ephemeral secrets. Error in GH actions logs: `Error: Not Found (403) - actions/checkout ...` seems tied to `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL` not being available on run-from-fork.

raj_code: seen that. Quick workaround is to gate the secrets fetch behind `if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository` but long-term we should fallback to a test-token in integration env.

maria_devex: noted — can we avoid adding special envs in docs? prefer to detect forks and print a friendly message in the action instead of failing the whole run.

lisa_pm: priority-wise — captions fix and CI determinism are both high for tomorrow's demo. Can we get the caption fix merged first? Demo requires readable captions.

noah_docs: will do caption wrapper patch, push tonight. I'll also add a small README note about how to regenerate VTTs (one-liners).

deploy-bot: [CI] sample-app (main) — Job e2e-tests failed — https://ci.redwoodinfra.internal/12345 — logs uploaded. :warning:

tess_swe: I started a quick PR with a soft-fail option for forks: if ephemeral secrets missing -> print notice and skip that step, mark test as skipped not failed. PTAL @maria_devex @raj_code (WIP: actions/ci.yml snippet below)
```yaml
- name: Fetch ephemeral secrets
  if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository }}
  run: ./scripts/fetch-ephemeral-secrets.sh
```

raj_code: LGTM for the gate. For the test-token fallback, I'll open a follow-up RFC that documents risk and rotation cadence.

maria_devex: actions: 1) @noah_docs patch caption wrapper + unit test (ETA tonight) 2) @tess_swe soft-fail PR for forks (merge when green) 3) @raj_code RFC for fallback token (low-risk) 4) I'll run link-checker across quickstarts after caption merge.

noah_docs: merging caption patch now to `devex/captions-fix` -> will open PR against `main` after CI. NOTE: I added step to produce speaker labels in VTT: `--preserve-speakers`.

lisa_pm: awesome — please ping me once PRs are merged so we can update demo checklist.

maria_devex: also small docs ask: there's a stale code sample in quickstart #78 referencing `client.generate_stream()` (old API). I'll file a docs PR to update to `client.responses.stream()` and include a tiny snippet showing structured output usage.

noah_docs: thanks — I'll review the sample API change; also reminder to add backwards migration note for teams upgrading from 0.x -> 1.0 in the SDK changelog.

maria_devex: final blocker for today: flaky link-checker on CI (intermittent 502s against docs CDN). If it keeps failing, I'll add a retry wrapper to the job to reduce noise.

deploy-bot: [CI] docs-link-checker — Job retried (1/3) due to transient 502. Logs: https://ci.redwoodinfra.internal/98765

tess_swe: if you want I can add exponential backoff in the GH step (`curl --retry 5 --retry-delay 2`). simple and effective.

maria_devex: great — can we do that as a quick patch and I'll follow up with retry metrics on Monday. Thanks all :sparkles:

(threads ends)
